message.content:
This document is a technical README for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & Models**
- Runs 320B-parameter GLM-5.3-Flash (18B active/token), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (428B, 23B active).
- Memory tiers: VRAM expert cache → pinned RAM
